notes.title: Version 0.7.69 Update
notes.content: [p]Bugs fixed:[/p][list][*][p]Purification Box Issue: Fixed the inability to exit by pressing "X" when fewer than 4 items are placed in the box.[/p][/*][*][p]Paper Doll Count Error: In the office building lobby, the number of paper dolls wrongly counted as 0 when 1 was left.[/p][/*][*][p]Menu Freeze Bug: Fixed the player being unable to move right after closing the menu due to Joe's shield skill.[/p][/*][/list][p]Optimization:[/p][list][*][p]Task Key Binding: Changed the "Alt" key function from "hold" to "click" for task activation.[/p][/*][*][p]Purification Box UI:[/p][p]  - Added error hints for invalid items placed in the box.[/p][p]  - Temporarily hides the ring and the coin when selecting the obsession items.[/p][/*][*][p]Sanity System:[/p][p]  - Significantly reduced sanity consumption from cursed items.[/p][p]  - Increased the quantity of sanity-restoring items in OMG mail attachments.[/p][/*][*][p]Workflow Improvements:[/p][p]  - Optimized the messages for interaction points during the "Retrieve ID card" process.[/p][p]  - Simplified the ID card usage procedure.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Version 0.7.68 Update
notes.content: [p]Bug Fixed:[/p][list][*][p]In Jolin's room, Joe's defense against the Peachwood Sword fails to trigger the storyline.[/p][/*][*][p]The player can walk upward through the wall near the meeting room door.[/p][/*][*][p]After the purification, detection items remain usable.[/p][/*][/list][p]Optimizations:[/p][list][*][p]Revised the dialogue after failed Spirit Pad attempts, strengthening the connection between ghost reactions and questions.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the OMG email to clarify the descriptions of the Spirit Pad and Voodoo doll.[/p][/*][/list]
